target_customer: Financial institutions, private equity firms and oil and gas operators that need independent methane emission data for oil and gas assets
problem: Methane emissions from oil and gas facilities are mostly estimated in spreadsheets, which the company claims underestimates actual emissions by about 70 percent.
business_model: Data and software subscriptions for asset level methane monitoring, sold to finance and energy companies
product_category: Climate tech, satellite methane emissions monitoring using public satellite data

founders.name: Robert Huppertz
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: machine learning engineer at NASA Harvest, also worked at Cervest. Education not listed.

founders.name: Jack Angela
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: leads product and commercial strategy. Background not listed.

competitors.name: GHGSat
competitors.what: Commercial satellites measuring methane from individual industrial sites
competitors.traction_then: two methane satellites in orbit, new contract in August 2023 with Spire to build four more

competitors.name: MethaneSAT
competitors.what: Nonprofit satellite for wide area methane measurement with public data
competitors.traction_then: pre launch, launch date shifting across sources

technical_complexity.rationale: Detecting and quantifying methane plumes from public multispectral satellite imagery requires custom machine learning and validation, which the company claims a 2023 Stanford study ranked first for accuracy and sensitivity.

defensibility.rationale: Detection algorithms and validated history on public data are hard but not impossible to copy; no owned satellite, so competitors using the same open imagery can follow.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established methane data vendors and satellite operators existed; no source shows them copying or buying Orbio.

market_need_then: Methane regulation and investor scrutiny of oil and gas assets were rising in 2022 and 2023, and the company cites a 70 percent underestimate in spreadsheet based reporting; early funding came from the climate VC Satgana and the ESA BIC.

branding.domain_note: Uses orbio.earth, a branded .earth domain matching the name.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific and finance oriented, cites a Stanford validation study

branding.brand_signature: Scan every oil and gas facility globally every couple of days

brand_strength.rationale: Brand coverage is limited to funding news and a Stanford study mention; the name is shared with unrelated Orbio companies.

outcome_analysis: Orbio Earth is active and raised a pre-seed in 2022 from Satgana and a 4M USD seed in March 2024 led by Initialized Capital after YC. It relies on public satellite data and proprietary detection, selling to finance and oil and gas, with regulation tailwinds. Larger satellite operators remain competitors, and later rounds are not found.
notes: Pre-seed reported as 600K EUR by EU-Startups, Impakter and Chronicle; amount in USD not converted, so amount_usd is null. Seed of 4M USD and a 16M USD valuation come from aggregators (Dealroom, CB Insights, StartupIntros); the valuation is an aggregator estimate. Totals differ: CB Insights 5.12M, StartupIntros 4.6M. EU-Startups returned 403 so it was not opened. Founding year 2021 per YC, 2023 in some profiles. Education not found.
